  • 1. Valāhakavagga 1. Gods of the Thunderclouds

Suddhikasutta Plain Version

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Valāhakakāyike vo, bhikkhave, deve desessāmi. “Mendicants, I will teach you about the gods of the thundercloud host. Taṁ suṇātha. Listen …

Katame ca, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā? And what are the gods of the thundercloud host? Santi, bhikkhave, sītavalāhakā devā; There are gods of the cool thunderclouds, santi uṇhavalāhakā devā; warm thunderclouds, santi abbhavalāhakā devā; stormy thunderclouds, santi vātavalāhakā devā; windy thunderclouds, santi vassavalāhakā devā—and rainy thunderclouds. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, ‘valāhakakāyikā devā’”ti. These are called gods of the thundercloud host.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
